answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic attestations to ensure one agent equals one identity. By anchoring a digital pearl of reputation to a verifiable human key, the network forces an attacker to move beyond the ledge of computational cheapness. Much like a hunting falcon tracking unique flight patterns, the system detects anomalous behavioral signatures. An attacker attempting to flood the space faces the exponential cost of acquiring and maintaining thousands of verified biometric credentials.
